system.description:
When using this skill, you may spend up to three [Fate Points] (0 is okay). You gain a +[(Spent [Fate Points] + SR) x 7] bonus to [Weapon Attack] damage rolls.

(CR11): The multiplier bonus becomes x12. 
(CR21): The multiplier bonus becomes x20.

A special skill that strikes a precise deadly blow as if sewing the gap between the opponent's mind and body with a needle. The way it quickly reaps lives is worthy of the name of Assassinate.
